heading: Pets on airplanes

tree.heading: Prohibition.—
tree.text: It shall be unlawful for any person to place a live animal in an overhead storage compartment of an aircraft operated under part 121 of title 14, Code of Federal Regulations.

tree.heading: Civil Penalty.—
tree.text: The Administrator may impose a civil penalty under section 46301 for each violation of this section.

sourceCredit: (Added Pub. L. 115–254, div. B, title IV, § 417(a), Oct. 5, 2018, 132 Stat. 3334.)
